meta.title: Participation Consent and Decline Capture: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that Participation Consent and Decline Capture is refused or absent.
Repeat the consent and decline actions as a Buyer, including recording a decline reason, and compare availability.
Determine whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants this capability to additional roles.
